about: Reviewed hits of the site's leak gate (scripts/leak-gate.mjs) that cannot be edited away here. Each row covers exactly `count` hits of that kind (and salted hash prefix) in that file: one more is a new leak and one fewer is a stale row, and both fail the deploy. A canary is never listed. The list carries a review stamp (the sha256 of its rows): any change to a row without a new stamp stops the deploy, and a term of a class with no allowlist (the client, an employer, a publisher) can never be listed. Short terms are not matched in raw compressed binary bytes, so chance spellings there need no row.
